trial_change: Move TX_P jack crossover via from (113.9,67.44) to (111.8,67.44); reshape two In2 and two F.Cu tracks, then refill.

checks.manual_review: KiCad F.Cu/In1/In2 copper plots inspected. The trial TX_P via antipad merges with the existing TX_N jack-pad antipad, unlike the isolated baseline via opening.

rejection_rationale: Shorter unsupported In2 run is offset by longer total TX_P route and increased whole-segment TX_P/TX_N path difference (0.960 to 1.683 mm). This is a screening metric, not exact electrical skew.
Merged antipads change the local return path; a net signal-integrity improvement has not been established. Clean DRC does not resolve that concern.
next_step: Review the complete jack crossover/return topology together with termination and ESD branches against manufacturer guidance. Do not repeat this isolated via move as an accepted improvement without return-path and pair-length justification.
limitations: No physical electrical validation, field simulation or fabrication approval. Issue #1 remains open.
